description:
## Outcome

        An output directory always has an explicit terminal or incomplete state after cancellation, task exit, stdout failure, artifact write failure, or limit stop. Completed JSONL records remain valid and recoverable.

        ## Why now

        The current manifest is written first and summary only at normal completion. A failure can leave an ambiguous directory after the runtime and evidence work is otherwise stable.

        ## Current state

        `JSONL.open/3` creates the manifest. `JSONL.finish/2` writes `summary.json` only after all streamed results finish. An emit or task failure stops enumeration. There is no planned/completed/missing list, terminal timestamp, or atomic final summary policy.

        ## Ownership and boundary

        This is a `jido_cli` artifact change. The CLI owns run lifecycle files, stdout/stderr, and status. Jidoka supplies cell outcomes only. Preserve existing source artifacts and never rewrite a complete JSONL line.

        ## Detailed implementation

        1. Add manifest lifecycle state and timestamps with an atomic update or separate terminal marker that does not corrupt source provenance.
2. Write final summary atomically through a temporary file and rename. Define `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`, and `incomplete`.
3. Include planned, started, completed, failed, cancelled, and missing cell IDs/sequences plus primary and cleanup/write errors.
4. On stdout failure, stop further stdout writes but make a best effort to finalize file artifacts and return execution error. On artifact failure, do not emit a partial JSON line.
5. Preserve all complete `results.jsonl` and by-agent lines. State whether a failed per-agent append makes the run incomplete.
6. Use injected writer and clock capabilities for every failure point.
7. Keep new-or-empty directory safety and 0600 file modes.

        ## Acceptance criteria

        - [ ] Normal run has terminal `completed` manifest/summary and all cells.
- [ ] Cancellation and limit stop list completed and missing work correctly.
- [ ] Task, stdout, result-file, by-agent, and summary write failures leave an explicit incomplete state when the filesystem permits.
- [ ] No JSONL file ends with a partial physical line.
- [ ] Existing files in a rejected nonempty directory remain unchanged.
- [ ] Primary execution error and finalization error are both preserved without secret data.

        ## Test plan

        - Success: concurrent complete run and atomic summary replacement.
- Invalid input: nonempty/unavailable/output-file target and invalid manifest transition.
- Runtime failure: injected task exit, cancel, stdout write failure, results append failure, by-agent failure, and summary rename failure.
- Boundary and security: artifact paths stay under root, file mode 0600, errors redacted, and no line corruption.
- Deterministic capability: injected writer/filesystem boundary, engine, clock, IDs, and cancellation.
- JSONL and exit status: validate every surviving line; exit 1 for execution/finalization failure and 64 for pre-run directory errors.

        ## Documentation

        Update the artifact directory contract with lifecycle states, atomicity, partial-run fields, recovery guidance, and failure/status table.

        ## Non-goals

        Do not resume a partial run. Do not repair arbitrary old directories. Do not add a database, comparison report, or remote artifact upload.

        ## Dependencies

        Blocking issues:

        - `jido_cli-tqg.2.4` — Cancel headless sequences through public Jidoka handles
- `jido_cli-tqg.3.8` — Publish requested and confirmed enforcement evidence
- `jido_cli-tqg.6.3` — Enforce bounded runtime limits and provider-aware admission

        Features unlocked by this story:

        - Reliable CI consumption of interrupted and failed runs

        ## Commit plan

        Create exactly one focused `jido_cli` commit. Use a message such as `feat(cli): finalize interrupted run artifacts (jido_cli-tqg.6.4)`. Do not include another backlog feature.

        ## Verification commands

        ```sh
        cd /Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_cli/jido_cli
mix test test/jido_cli/cli/automation/jsonl_test.exs test/jido_cli/cli/automation/artifact_integrity_test.exs test/jido_cli/cli/automation_test.exs
mix quality
mix test --cover
mix docs
        ```
title: Finalize partial artifact directories after interruption
